A keyword search of all four log groups for the window (02:06:48 to 02:16:48 UTC) returned no error, exception, timeout or AccessDenied lines. Recent invocations completed normally, with CrudApi around 30-40 ms, Uploader around 90 ms, Thumbnailer around 100 ms and Compression around 550 ms, all well within their timeouts. The Thumbnailer (01:56:27) and Compression (00:39:27) configurations were modified before the window, but the modified values still match the IaC, so they do not explain any anomaly in this window.

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Transform: AWS::Serverless-2016-10-31
Description: >
  Benchmark application for the thesis "Cross-Layer Context for LLM-Based Detection and
  Root-Cause Analysis of Configuration Anomalies in AWS Lambda". Four SeBS functions
  (Table 3.2). This template is the intended state of the application.

Globals:
  Function:
    Runtime: python3.12
    Architectures: [x86_64]
    Tracing: PassThrough
    LoggingConfig:
      LogFormat: Text

Resources:
  # --------

input.query_string: fields @logStream, @message | filter @message like /ERROR|Error|error|AccessDenied|Task timed out|denied|Exception/ | sort @timestamp desc | limit 50
